claim.expected_behavior: A user of the skill converts an IC50 given in molar concentration to pIC50 by taking the base-10 logarithm and negating it, so that pIC50 = -log10(IC50 in M).
claim.statement: pIC50 is defined as the negative base-10 logarithm of the IC50 expressed in molar units: pIC50 = -log10(IC50_in_M).

question:
An enzyme inhibitor has a measured IC50 of 1 nM. What is its pIC50?

Reply with the number only on the first line, with no other text.
